preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100.
The size of each array is between 5 and 500.

preconditions.expression: Each array is a permutation of integers from 1 to n.
preconditions.description: Each array in the input is a permutation of the numbers 1 through n.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 500.
preconditions.description: The total number of elements across all arrays does not exceed 500.

postconditions.expression: The first line of the output contains the number of good subsets modulo 998244353.
postconditions.description: The output must include the count of good subsets, calculated modulo 998244353.

postconditions.expression: The second line of the output contains n indices of the arrays forming a good subset.
postconditions.description: The output must include a specific set of n indices from 1 to 2n that form a good subset.

invariants.expression: Each test case has exactly 2n lines, each with n integers.
invariants.description: Each test case consists of 2n lines, with each line containing n integers.

invariants.expression: No two arrays in the input are completely equal.
invariants.description: There are no duplicate arrays in the input.

invariants.expression: The arrays form a Latin square for the first n arrays.
invariants.description: The first n arrays must form a Latin square when arranged as a matrix.

invariants.expression: For each array, there is at least one position where the element matches the corresponding element in another array.
invariants.description: For every array, there is a match with one of the additional n arrays.
